- `tokio-util/src/util/poll_buf.rs:63`, in `poll_read_buf`.
- `tokio/src/io/read_buf.rs:83`, in `ReadBuf::take`.
- `tokio/src/io/util/read_buf.rs:55`, in `poll`. This `poll` belongs to a different type also named `ReadBuf`: the future in `io/util`, not the buffer type.
- `tokio/src/io/util/read_to_end.rs:86`, in `poll_read_to_end`. Line 85 next to it calls `MaybeUninit::uninit`, which doesn't count.
- `tokio/src/io/util/vec_with_initialized.rs:87`, in `VecWithInitialized::get_read_buf`.

The other matches were either `MaybeUninit::uninit` or in `tokio/tests/io_read_buf.rs`, which is test code.
